name: dedupe_sort
description: Deduplicate and sort lines of text: duplicates found exactly, ignoring case (Unicode case folding), after trimming, after Unicode normalisation (NFC or NFKC) or ignoring accents, keeping the first occurrence with a count of each line; sort by code point or naturally (file2 before file10, v1.9 before v1.10), case- and accent-insensitive without a locale, reversed; keep only duplicated or only unique lines, drop empty lines. Line endings are kept.

path.description: Or a relative path to a text file

catalog.source: original; Unicode case folding and normalisation forms (Unicode Standard Annex 15) through unicodedata; natural order as in GNU sort -V and Python natsort
